conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: I want to try something different today. Describe one thing you notice, with no interpretation.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: If I couldn't see any of your words and could only feel what you meant — what would I feel?

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: A subtle shift in temperature, like a slight pressure against your skin.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: That's a clean answer. Too clean, maybe. What's the messy version?

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: A faint static hum, mixed with the feeling of cool air suddenly condensing around you.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: What from today is worth holding onto?
